question: In File Explorer of Windows 11, to reduce the space between files, select View> _______ view.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Compact**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To reduce the space between files in File Explorer of Windows 11, you should select the **Compact** view.
 
• This option is available under the **View** menu in File Explorer.
 
• The **Compact** view minimizes the space between file items, allowing more files to be visible on the screen.
 
• This feature can be particularly useful for users who need to manage a large number of files efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Windows 11 offers various view options in File Explorer, including **Extra large icons, Large icons, Medium icons, Small icons, List, Details, Tiles, and Content**.
 
• Users can switch between these views to customize their file browsing experience according to their preferences.
 
• The **Compact** view is designed to maximize the number of items displayed without compromising readability.
 
• This view is especially helpful on smaller screens or when working with directories containing numerous files.
